prompt:
Create a TALL VERTICAL PORTRAIT image, approximately 1024 wide by 1536 high, definitely NOT landscape. One scene for a narrow comic panel. Dramatic pastoral watercolor and gouache graphic novel with fine selective ink, natural faces, rich warm/cool predawn light.
Same young Polish soldier Yitzhak as supplied reference photo and scene, age about twenty, narrow oval face, natural brown eyes, pronounced ears and straight nose. Same early Polish military cap and uniform. He is alerting a fellow soldier who was resting beside the river before dawn. Show Yitzhak's face at middle-right at 48% image height; one fellow soldier's face lower near center, looking up at him. Both faces fit in the narrow central 55% image width and between 35% and 70% image height. Other unit members, if visible, are indistinct backs in the distance, not extra foreground faces. Their bodies can overlap vertically, not spread horizontally. Clear purposeful waking gesture, no shouting text, no battle, no aiming weapons. Misty river and wooden bridge softly behind them. The entire upper-left quarter is low-detail pale blue-grey mist for later live caption, no faces there. At least 15% overscan around all important content. One single scene, no montage, no panels, no frames, no lettering or bubbles. Keep the human action readable even in a tight vertical crop.
tool_output_hint:
Generated images are saved to /workspace/generated_images as /workspace/generated_images/exec-dc30d930-62e5-4a28-9630-678745084927.png by default.
If you need to use a generated image at another path, copy it and leave the original in place unless the user explicitly asks you to delete it.
The generated image is already displayed to the user. There is no need to render it in the final response as a Markdown image or file link.
